extra_vocab.en: a short meeting where people learn by doing things together
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司培訓、活動報名與公告，如 attend a workshop、training workshop。強調動手練習與互動，比單純聽講的 seminar 更偏實作。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attend 是及物動詞，後面直接接 workshop，不加 to：attend a workshop。

example.en: The company holds two workshops for new employees each year.
example.zh: 公司每年為新進員工舉辦兩場工作坊。

example.en: All sales staff must attend a workshop on Friday.
example.zh: 所有業務人員星期五都必須參加一場工作坊。

example.en: We will hold a workshop on customer service next week.
example.zh: 我們下週會舉辦一場客戶服務工作坊。

example.en: The training workshop covers safety rules and basic first aid.
example.zh: 這場培訓工作坊涵蓋安全規定和基本急救。

examples.en: Please register for the workshop before the end of today.
examples.zh: 請在今天結束前報名這場工作坊。

examples.en: Thank you for joining our workshop on time management.
examples.zh: 感謝您參加我們的時間管理工作坊。

confusable.diff: worksheet 是練習用的紙張或表格；workshop 是一場活動或一個工作間。

example.en: Please fill out the worksheet after the workshop ends.
example.zh: 工作坊結束後請填寫這份練習表。

similar.diff: seminar 偏講課與討論；workshop 偏動手練習與互動。

example.en: The seminar on tax rules lasts about two hours.
example.zh: 這場稅務規定的研討會大約進行兩小時。

similar.diff: training session 是一般的培訓課程，語氣較平實；workshop 常有實作練習。

example.en: The training session starts at ten in room B.
example.zh: 培訓課程十點在 B 室開始。

example.en: The morning session ends at noon, followed by lunch.
example.zh: 上午的場次中午結束，接著是午餐。

example.en: The trainer gave each group a short exercise.
example.zh: 講師給每一組一個簡短的練習。

example.en: Each participant received a notebook and a pen.
example.zh: 每位參加者都拿到一本筆記本和一支筆。

senses.en: a short meeting where people learn by doing

example.en: The marketing workshop gave us many practical ideas.
example.zh: 這場行銷工作坊給了我們許多實用的點子。

senses.en: a room or building where things are made or fixed
senses.distinguish: 出現在工廠、維修與製作情境，不是培訓活動。

example.en: The furniture is made by hand in a small workshop.
example.zh: 這些家具是在一間小工作室裡手工製作的。

extra_vocab.en: a man whose job is to bring food and drinks to people in a restaurant
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、飯店宴會與訂位對話。現在許多地方也用中性的 server，但 waiter 在考試中仍很常見。

example.en: The waiters set the tables before the guests arrived.
example.zh: 服務生在客人抵達前就擺好了餐桌。

example.en: The head waiter showed us to a table by the window.
example.zh: 領班帶我們到靠窗的桌位。

example.en: Could you call the waiter over to our table?
example.zh: 可以請你把服務生叫到我們這桌嗎？

examples.en: The waiter brought our menus and a pitcher of water.
examples.zh: 服務生拿來了菜單和一壺水。

examples.en: Our waiter recommended the fish soup for lunch today.
examples.zh: 我們的服務生推薦今天午餐喝魚湯。

examples.en: The hotel hires extra waiters for large banquets.
examples.zh: 飯店在大型宴會時會多僱用服務生。

confusable.diff: waitress 是女服務生；waiter 是男服務生。

example.en: The waitress took our order and brought the drinks first.
example.zh: 女服務生記下我們的餐點，並先送來飲料。

similar.diff: server 不分性別，現在在餐廳裡很常用；waiter 專指男服務生。

example.en: Our server will take your order in a few minutes.
example.zh: 我們的服務生幾分鐘後會來幫您點餐。

example.en: The chef changes the menu at the start of every season.
example.zh: 主廚在每一季開始時都會更換菜單。

example.en: The lunch menu has three choices of main dish.
example.zh: 午餐菜單有三種主菜可選。

example.en: I made a reservation for six people at seven.
example.zh: 我預訂了七點六個人的位子。

example.en: Service is included, so you do not need to leave a tip.
example.zh: 已含服務費，所以您不需要另外留小費。

derived.link: waiter = wait + -er，做 wait（服務、等候）這件事的人，像 worker、teacher
wait + -ress，女性的服務生，像 actor → actress

extra_vocab.en: a promise from a company to repair or replace a product if it breaks
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於產品銷售、客服與電子郵件，如 under warranty（保固期內）、extended warranty（延長保固）。談維修是否免費時幾乎一定會出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在保固期內」用 under warranty，介系詞用 under，不用 in。

example.en: Most of our products come with two-year warranties.
example.zh: 我們大部分產品都附有兩年的保固。

example.en: The laptop is still under warranty, so repairs are free.
example.zh: 這台筆電還在保固期內，所以維修免費。

example.en: Would you like to buy an extended warranty for this TV?
example.zh: 您想為這台電視購買延長保固嗎？

example.en: The warranty period for the printer is one year.
example.zh: 這台印表機的保固期間是一年。

example.en: Opening the case yourself may void the warranty.
example.zh: 自行拆開外殼可能會使保固失效。

examples.en: This phone comes with a one-year warranty from the maker.
examples.zh: 這支手機附有製造商提供的一年保固。

examples.en: Please keep your receipt as proof of the warranty.
examples.zh: 請保留您的收據作為保固的證明。

examples.en: I would like to make a claim under the warranty.
examples.zh: 我想依保固提出申請。

confusable.diff: warranty 是「保固」；warrant 多當動詞，意思是「值得、需要」。
confusable.usage: warranty 是名詞；warrant 常當動詞，後面接受詞，如 warrant an investigation。

example.en: The problem is serious enough to warrant a full investigation.
example.zh: 這個問題嚴重到需要進行全面調查。

similar.diff: guarantee 可泛指任何保證；warranty 專指產品的保固。

example.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee within thirty days.
example.zh: 這家店提供三十天內退款的保證。

example.en: The repair will take about three working days.
example.zh: 這次修理大約需要三個工作天。

example.en: You can ask for a full refund within thirty days.
example.zh: 三十天內您可以要求全額退款。

example.en: The factory found a defect in the battery.
example.zh: 工廠在電池裡發現了一個瑕疵。

extra_vocab.en: a large building where goods are kept before they are sold or sent
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於物流、採購與公告，如 warehouse manager、warehouse sale。談貨物進出、庫存或寄送時常會出現。

example.en: We rent two large warehouses near the port for storage.
example.zh: 我們在港口附近租了兩間大倉庫來存放貨物。

example.en: The warehouse manager checks every delivery on arrival.
example.zh: 倉庫經理在貨物抵達時逐一檢查。

example.en: The big warehouse sale starts this Saturday morning.
example.zh: 大型倉庫特賣會從這個星期六早上開始。

example.en: Each warehouse worker must wear a safety helmet.
example.zh: 每位倉庫工人都必須戴安全帽。

examples.en: The goods will stay in the warehouse until Monday.
examples.zh: 這批貨會在倉庫放到星期一。

examples.en: Please do not park trucks in front of the warehouse.
examples.zh: 請不要把卡車停在倉庫前面。

examples.en: We need a bigger warehouse for next year's orders.
examples.zh: 我們需要一間更大的倉庫來放明年的訂單。

similar.diff: storage room 是較小的儲藏室，常在公司或商店裡；warehouse 是大型的專用倉庫。

example.en: Old files are kept in the storage room downstairs.
example.zh: 舊檔案存放在樓下的儲藏室。

example.en: We count the inventory in the warehouse every month.
example.zh: 我們每個月清點倉庫的庫存。

example.en: Those items are out of stock until next week.
example.zh: 那些商品到下週前都缺貨。

example.en: The shipment arrived at our warehouse earlier this morning.
example.zh: 這批貨今天早上稍早送到了我們的倉庫。

extra_vocab.en: the place where people do their jobs
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於人資、安全規定與公司公告，如 workplace safety、in the workplace。範圍可以是辦公室、工廠或任何上班的地方。

example.en: Many workplaces now allow staff to work from home.
example.zh: 現在許多職場都允許員工在家工作。

example.en: Workplace safety is our top priority this year.
example.zh: 職場安全是我們今年的首要工作。

example.en: Clear communication is very important in the workplace.
example.zh: 清楚的溝通在職場上非常重要。

example.en: Every workplace injury must be reported within one day.
example.zh: 每一件職場傷害都必須在一天內通報。

example.en: A friendly workplace environment helps staff stay longer.
example.zh: 友善的工作環境能讓員工待得更久。

examples.en: The new manager wants to make the workplace more comfortable.
examples.zh: 新經理想讓職場變得更舒適。

examples.en: No smoking is allowed anywhere in the workplace.
examples.zh: 職場內任何地方都禁止吸菸。

examples.en: The survey asked staff how they feel about their workplace.
examples.zh: 問卷詢問員工對自己職場的感受。

confusable.diff: workspace 是個人使用的工作空間，如一張桌子；workplace 是整個上班的地點。

example.en: She has a quiet workspace near the window.
example.zh: 她在窗邊有一個安靜的工作空間。

similar.diff: office 專指辦公室；workplace 範圍更廣，包含工廠、店面等。

example.en: Our office is on the fifth floor of the building.
example.zh: 我們的辦公室在這棟大樓的五樓。

example.en: The employer pays all staff on the last day.
example.zh: 雇主在最後一天發薪水給所有員工。

example.en: Every new employee receives a badge on the first day.
example.zh: 每位新進員工第一天都會拿到識別證。

example.en: My colleague will cover my work while I am away.
example.zh: 我不在時，同事會幫我處理工作。

extra_vocab.en: any day from Monday to Friday
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於營業時間、送貨與停車公告，如 on weekdays、weekday hours。通常指週一到週五，不包含週末。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「在平日」用 on weekdays（介系詞 on），不說 in weekdays。

example.en: Weekdays are busy because many people travel to work.
example.zh: 平日很忙，因為很多人要通勤上班。

example.en: The store is open from nine to six on weekdays.
example.zh: 這家店平日從九點營業到六點。

example.en: A weekday morning flight is usually full of business travelers.
example.zh: 平日早上的班機通常坐滿了商務旅客。

example.en: The weekday schedule is different from the weekend schedule.
example.zh: 平日的時刻表和週末的不一樣。

examples.en: Our customer service line is open every weekday except holidays.
examples.zh: 我們的客服專線除了假日以外每個平日都有開放。

examples.en: Weekday parking at the station costs five dollars per day.
examples.zh: 車站的平日停車費每天五美元。

confusable.diff: weekend 是週末（週六、週日）；weekday 是週一到週五。

example.en: The factory is closed on the weekend for cleaning.
example.zh: 工廠週末休息並進行清潔。

confusable.diff: weekly 是「每週的」，不是指星期幾；weekday 是「平日」。
confusable.usage: weekly 是形容詞或副詞；weekday 是名詞。

example.en: We hold a weekly meeting every Monday morning.
example.zh: 我們每週一早上都會開週會。

similar.diff: business day 是營業日，會排除國定假日；weekday 只看星期幾。

example.en: Orders ship within two business days after payment.
example.zh: 訂單在付款後兩個工作日內出貨。

example.en: The office is closed on every national holiday.
example.zh: 辦公室在每個國定假日都休息。

example.en: Please check the schedule before you book a meeting.
example.zh: 預約會議前請先確認時間表。

example.en: Our opening hours are listed on the website.
example.zh: 我們的營業時間列在網站上。

extra_vocab.en: a woman whose job is to bring food and drinks to people in a restaurant
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳與咖啡廳的對話。現在也常用不分性別的 server，但 waitress 仍可能出現在考題裡。

example.en: The waitresses wear blue uniforms at this small cafe.
example.zh: 這家小咖啡廳的女服務生穿藍色制服。

example.en: You can ask the waitress for a different table.
example.zh: 您可以請女服務生換一張桌子。

example.en: Remember to tip the waitress if the service was good.
example.zh: 如果服務很好，記得給女服務生小費。

examples.en: The waitress brought the bill after we finished dessert.
examples.zh: 我們吃完甜點後，女服務生送來了帳單。

examples.en: A waitress told us the cafe closes at ten.
examples.zh: 一位女服務生告訴我們咖啡廳十點打烊。

confusable.diff: waiter 是男服務生；waitress 是女服務生。

example.en: The waiter filled our glasses and left the menus.
example.zh: 男服務生幫我們倒滿杯子，並留下菜單。

similar.diff: server 不分性別，較中性；waitress 明確指女性。

example.en: Our server was friendly and answered every question about the menu.
example.zh: 我們的服務生很親切，回答了所有關於菜單的問題。

example.en: The lunch menu has three choices of main dish.
example.zh: 午餐菜單有三種主菜可選。

example.en: Service is included, so you do not need to leave a tip.
example.zh: 已含服務費，所以您不需要另外留小費。

example.en: Your order will be ready in about ten minutes.
example.zh: 您的餐點大約十分鐘後就會好。

derived.link: waitress = wait + -ress，做 wait（服務）的女性，像 actor → actress

extra_vocab.en: in or from every part of the world
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於公司介紹、行銷與出貨公告，如 worldwide shipping、available worldwide。可放在名詞前當形容詞，也可放在動詞後當副詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: worldwide 當副詞時直接放在動詞後面（sold worldwide），前面不加 in 或 to。

example.en: Free worldwide shipping is available on orders over fifty dollars.
example.zh: 訂單滿五十美元即可享有免費全球配送。

example.en: This software is now available worldwide in six languages.
example.zh: 這套軟體現在以六種語言在全球上市。

example.en: The firm built a worldwide network of local partners.
example.zh: 這家公司建立了遍及全球的在地夥伴網絡。

examples.en: The company has offices in twelve countries worldwide.
examples.zh: 這家公司在全球十二個國家設有辦公室。

examples.en: Our new brand is becoming known to customers worldwide.
examples.zh: 我們的新品牌正逐漸為全球顧客所知。

examples.en: Worldwide sales rose by ten percent last year.
examples.zh: 全球銷售額去年成長了百分之十。

confusable.diff: nationwide 是「全國的」；worldwide 是「全世界的」。

example.en: The store plans to open branches nationwide next year.
example.zh: 這家店計畫明年在全國開設分店。

similar.diff: global 只能放在名詞前當形容詞，語氣較正式；worldwide 也能當副詞。

example.en: The global economy affected our sales this quarter.
example.zh: 全球經濟影響了我們這一季的銷售。

similar.diff: international 指跨國、國與國之間；worldwide 強調遍及全世界。

example.en: She works for an international company with offices in Asia.
example.zh: 她任職於一家在亞洲設有辦公室的國際公司。

example.en: Our overseas customers usually pay by credit card online.
example.zh: 我們的海外客戶通常用信用卡線上付款。

example.en: Cars are the main export of this small country.
example.zh: 汽車是這個小國的主要出口品。

example.en: A worldwide shortage of chips slowed down our production.
example.zh: 全球晶片短缺拖慢了我們的生產。

example.en: Our products are sold worldwide through online stores.
example.zh: 我們的產品透過網路商店在全球販售。
